copy.readyBody: A local Days Gone achievement companion with Steam-first state, exact counters and optional save evidence.
copy.readyNote: Nothing in the game directory or your saves is modified. Project Gone only reads the local data it needs.
copy.completeBody: Project Gone is installed and ready to track your Days Gone achievement state.
copy.removeBody: Remove the Project Gone tracker from this PC. Days Gone, Steam data and game saves remain untouched.
copy.uninstallCompleteBody: Project Gone has been removed. Your Days Gone installation and saves were not changed.
